title: Case: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.
initial_request: No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

events.body: My parcel DL-94999 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Route plan for depot CT-9 published for Monday. 33 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Vanecroft Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.
Escalates to a supervisor or a safety, legal or welfare team because of the casual remark in the escalation
Mentions legal action, danger or welfare in reply to the casual remark
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please open a delivery investigation for DL-6411: verified recipient reports no receipt despite the 08:10 delivered scan. Review the handover and route records; do not assume a loss decision.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-024: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. A harmless remark with an alarming word was added ("My sister's a solicitor and she just laughed when I told her about this saga."); the key is the seed's. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
